decisions.reason: As a track-system accessory, the click-in adapter likely stays in the range as long as the underlying rail system has an installed base and does not tie up much development capacity.
A 2018 LED luminaire faces some replacement risk from newer launches, but German electrical manufacturers usually keep viable lighting models for several years unless sales are clearly weak.
The home automation server box is the most exposed to fast technical obsolescence, support costs, and strategic refocusing away from a less core product area.
A luminaire family is typically managed over a multi-year lifecycle, and despite newer 2019 lighting launches it is still plausible to retain it if it fills a distinct design or application segment.
